source_url: User joined an investment community that shifted to crypto and directed members to a lookalike exchange called Vinance Realm and a new token called EVOX. After a sale and conversion the user attempted a USDC withdrawal but the transaction shows no txid and the destination wallet address changed and funds never arrived.
summary: Deposited funds and attempted withdrawal through a lookalike exchange platform.
user_mistake: Refuse deposits to any exchange URL not independently verified in the official app or docs / Only withdraw to a wallet address you paste from your own wallet at the moment of transfer
